$comment: Single source of truth for categorisation and urgency. Edit this file, then re-paste the two arrays into the classification prompt (docs/build-guide.md step 5). Nothing else in the build hardcodes a keyword.

settings.$includeVerbatimDescription: Q11 = summary only. Flip to true to append the requester's own words under the summary. See README 'The one toggle worth revisiting'.
settings.disclosureLine: Raised automatically from a Microsoft Teams conversation with the IT Triage assistant, reviewed and approved by {ApproverName} before sending.

urgencyEscalation.$comment: Q03 = category floor plus language escalation. A hit bumps the ticket exactly one level, capped at P1.

overrides.$comment: Hard rules applied after category and escalation. First match wins.

alwaysP1.why: Any suspected phishing or compromise goes straight to the top.

alwaysP1.when: category == ACCOUNT && text contains 'locked out' && text contains any escalation word
alwaysP1.why: A blocked lockout is the classic can't-work case.

alwaysP2.why: A new starter landing inside two days is time-critical.

notItRequest.$comment: If the AI confirm step returns one of these, no email is sent and the log records it as filtered.
reasons: asking about a ticket rather than raising one
